email.body1:
Katie, saw Olo closed the Spendgo deal and is launching the commission-free Olo Network this year.

Back-to-back M&A and a new network usually open more accounts than the sales team can cover before momentum fades, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for Olo.

Post-acquisition, the number usually climbs faster than the team can ramp. Most sales orgs cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new target, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech leaders. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Katie, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything mid-integration, and I know absorbing an acquisition while launching a network is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Olo either way.
